messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT P1 — Elevated 5xx & timeouts for tenant `auroraedge` on dedicated-us-east-1. Alerting oncall. Monitoring: https://metrics.internal/redwood/auroraedge/5xx (sig increase 08:12 UTC)
oncall-ryan: I got the page, looking. Acknowledge.

oncall-ryan: quick status: seeing 5xx climb to ~18% over last 5m, p95 latency up to 3.2s, request rate ~1.2k rps for that tenant. Will pull logs and infra metrics.

marta: likely noisy neighbor or KV eviction thrash — saw similar pattern yesterday. tagging @chris infra to verify GPU and KV pressure.

chris: checking node metrics for dedicated-us-east-1 pool...
```
node-42: gpu_util=95% mem.free=1.2GB kv_evictions=420/s inflight=480
node-43: gpu_util=92% mem.free=1.0GB kv_evictions=410/s inflight=450
avg_queue_len=1200 (threshold 300)
```

chris: KV eviction rate is through the roof, LRU churn high. Inflight queue is saturating. Tenant `auroraedge` accounts for ~65% of inflight ops on that pool.

oncall-ryan: can we confirm that requests failing are 5xx from our runtime (5xx-gateway / 5xx-kv / 5xx-timeout)?

ops_jun: sampling 5xx logs now. Pattern: `kv cache miss -> dyn route -> model runtime timeout -> 502` for long outputs. Example: 
```
[08:09:45] tenant=auroraedge req_id=abc123 status=502 error="runtime_timeout" latency=12.3s
[08:09:46] tenant=auroraedge req_id=abc124 status=504 error="kv_eviction_miss" latency=10.8s
```

chris: yeah, looks like eviction + high GPU causing backend timeouts. Not a model bug.

marta: immediate mitigation suggestions: 1) apply short-term rate limit per-tenant to protect pool 2) evict heavy tenant from shared pool to isolation/burst pool 3) route new requests for that tenant to hosted fallback if available.

oncall-ryan: roll with that plan. @infra-bot can you run `tenant-evict` for auroraedge and enable hosted fallback?

infra-bot: Running commands.
```
# move tenant to burst pool (ephemeral capacity)
rcli tenant move --tenant auroraedge --from dedicated-us-east-1 --to burst-east-1 --reason "noisy_neighbor_auto"
# enable hosted fallback route
rcli route add-fallback --tenant auroraedge --target hosted-us-east --policy immediate
# apply gateway rate limit
gatewayctl set-rate-limit --tenant auroraedge --limit 200rps --window 1s --reason "protect_pool"
```

infra-bot: move started -> nodes draining, flows rewired. Hosted fallback route added. Gateway rate limit applied.

support-liaison: customer impact estimate for comms team: `~24%` of auroraedge requests failed between 08:05-08:15 UTC. Estimated affected customer sessions: ~1.1k active API clients. Drafting note to send after stabilization.

chris: eviction logs: 
```
[08:14:02] eviction: tenant=auroraedge container=run-842 removed from node-42
[08:14:05] migration: tenant=auroraedge traffic shifted to burst-east-1 (3 nodes)
```

ops_jun: after migration: GPU util on shared pool dropped to 60% and kv_evictions down to 45/s. Inflight queue len now ~240. 

oncall-ryan: good. Any errors on burst-east-1?

infra-bot: burst-east-1 nodes show gpu_util ~88% but latency on hosted fallback is lower; overall 5xx for auroraedge dropped from 18% -> 3% in 10 min.

marta: will keep rate limit until we see stable p95 < 500ms and 5xx < 1%. Also recommend temporary SLA downgrade notice for affected customers while we stabilize.

support-liaison: sent initial customer note: "We're investigating elevated errors. We've temporarily rerouted traffic to preserve availability; you may see degraded throughput. We'll follow up with root cause and ETA." Customer reply: "Thanks — please keep us posted, this impacts our production window."

oncall-ryan: infra-team, request capacity scale: can we spin up +2 dedicated nodes in us-east-1 and add reservation for auroraedge after stabilization? Need replacement where eviction was.

infra-bot: scaling group request submitted: `asg-dedicated-us-east` desired +2 nodes. Estimated ready in ~6m.

chris: monitoring autoscale — once nodes join we'll consider moving tenant back to reserved slice or create dedicated hostpool. Current priority is stop the noisy churn.

elaine: I'm taking handoff at 08:30 UTC (next oncall). Summary for you @elaine: noisy neighbor `auroraedge` caused KV eviction churn + GPU saturation -> runtime timeouts -> elevated 5xx. We migrated tenant to burst pool and enabled hosted fallback; applied 200rps gateway limit. Metrics improving (5xx 18% -> 3%). ASG scale requested. Customer notified.

elaine: ack. continuing monitoring. If 5xx rebounds >5% revert rate limit tighter and consider temporary tenant suspend until capacity is available.

ops_jun: ASG nodes active at 08:36 UTC. New nodes reporting and joining pool.

chris: after new nodes joined, moved auroraedge back to dedicated-us-east-1 on isolated pool `auroraedge-reserved-1`. Post-move checks: GPU util for isolated pool ~72%, kv_evictions ~12/s, inflight ~220. 5xx now ~0.7% last 5m.

marta: assigning post-incident action items: - reserve dedicated slice for auroraedge (ops) - add tenant-level soft throttling in control-plane (devex) - improve KV LRU tuning to avoid full-churn scenarios (eng-runtime) - add monitoring alert for single-tenant inflight > 50% of pool (sre)

support-liaison: sending final customer update: "Traffic restored. We migrated you to an isolated capacity slice and applied protections to avoid recurrence. We're following up with a root-cause and improvements." Customer: "Thanks — appreciate the fast action."

oncall-ryan: closing notes: incident mitigated, keep oncall watch for 1h, postmortem draft assigned to @marta.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: Resolved for tenant `auroraedge`. Severity downgraded to P2 at 08:47 UTC.

elaine: will run 24h regression checks and validate autoscale triggers.

marta: postmortem checklist created: link https://docs.internal/incidents/1768004321-auroraedge-pm. Action owners assigned.

support-liaison: closing customer comms loop; they requested invoice credit consideration, escalated to account team.

oncall-ryan: thanks everyone.

elaine: closing thread — monitoring stable, no ongoing customer impact. :white_check_mark:
